text:
anya: Quick sync — want to propose an ambassador/referral pipeline to speed DP recruitment for the Optimize beta. low lift, scalable. thoughts?

mike: love it. what are we optimizing for? speed of onboarding vs signal quality?

anya: both, but prioritize high-signal early adopters (platform teams + startup infra owners). we can batch a small cohort first.

tara: screening idea: require short intake form + 30min kickoff call. must have a measurable inference workload (>=100 qps or 100k tokens/day) or clear ROI case.

raj: channels: existing dp list, partners, linkedin ads (targeted), and existing dedicated customers (ask AMs). also consider a 1:1 outreach by SEs for high-value targets.

emily: drafted a short outreach template — keep it <3 sentences and include 1-click apply. example attached below.

emily: ```Hi NAME — we’re running a short beta for Redwood Optimize (cost/latency toolkit). Want to try on your inference workload? ~4 week pilot, fast setup, priority engineering support. Apply: <link>```

mike: incentives: early pricing credits + 2 weeks of free tuning + public case study option (opt-in). can offer anonymous telemetry if they want privacy. :money_with_wings:

anya: legal/data: need NDA checkbox and clear data usage lines. Tara, can you confirm what telemetry we need (metrics, traces, aggregated tokens)?

tara: we only need aggregate token/cost/latency metrics + sample prompts for quality checks. no PII. enforce upload via secure form and optional KMS.

raj: ops note — we need CS handoff doc and a config playbook for on-call during pilot weeks. also capacity gating if too many cohorts.

mike: timeline proposal: week 0 recruit, week 1 onboarding + baseline, weeks 2–3 tuning + feedback, week 4 wrap + success review. run first cohort next month.

anya: success criteria (draft): 1) onboarding <48h, 2) end-to-end latency improvement or cost reduction >=20% for >=50% of cohort, 3) minimum NPS feedback score >=7, 4) 1 case study or 3 positive quotes.

tara: add retention/activation metric: percentage of beta customers that convert to paid Dedicated/Optimize config within 90 days.

emily: I can wire up the apply form + Airtable. will include intake fields: company, infra, current model(s), baseline metrics, use-case, willingness for case study, legal contact.

anya: perfect. Raj — can you coordinate AM outreach? Mike/Tara — finalize incentives + telemetry list. Emily — share the form link by EOD Friday. I’ll draft a short internal docs page for engineering onboarding.

raj: noted — will ping AMs today.

cs_bot: <recruitment-spreadsheet> created by emily. Link: https://airtable.com/shrExample123 — everyone with access can add leads. :robot_face:

mike: tiny ask — can we add a field for "expected QPS / tokens/day" in the form. helps capacity planning.

emily: added. also added a checkbox for 'need private deployment' to route to sales.

anya: OK next steps: 1) outreach copy + form (emily) 2) AM/SE outbound (raj) 3) finalize success metrics + NDA language (mike/tara) 4) engineering runbook for onboarding (anya). Weekly check-ins on Wed.

tara: can we also collect 3 canonical prompts from each partner to use in regression/quality evals?

anya: yes — make that part of intake + kickoff.

mike: :thumbsup: small follow-up — budget for credits/SE time approved from product reserve.

raj: will start triage ladder so high-value leads get fast track.

emily: I’ll post apply link in #product-community and schedule a demo slot for applicants.

anya: great work team. will share the internal summary and kickoff checklist in this thread tomorrow. :sparkles:
